Throughput is scaled directly on layer 1 with parallel execution, transaction sharing and built-in rollup support.
A simpler, safer and faster experience on one chain.

page-layer-2-network-of-networks-title: One chain, not a network of networks
page-layer-2-network-of-networks-descrip: Quantaureum is a single quantum-secure layer-1 blockchain. Scalability is embedded in the protocol itself rather than delegated to external networks.
page-layer-2-ready-to-start-description: Have a look at all the different networks that are available to you.
page-layer-2-why-do-we-need-multiple-net: Why does a single layer 1 need multiple scaling layers?
Why add multiple execution networks instead of scaling one Quantaureum chain?
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-1-title: How do I know that a network is part of Quantaureum?
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-1-descri: Quantaureum scales directly on layer 1, so there is no need to trust a separate network. The protocol uses parallel execution, transaction sharing and built-in rollup support to raise throughput while keeping security and decentralization on the main chain.
Some specific industries might not require such direct close relationship such as gaming or non-financial applications where different technologies are better fit.
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-2-descri: While generally designed with robust security features, their safety depends on the underlying technology, smart contract security, and
Users should perform due diligence, starting with small transactions and staying updated on developments to ensure secure usage.
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-3-title: Why can't Quantaureum scale its own chain instead of relying on these networks?
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-3-descri: Quantaureum does scale its own chain. Instead of deferring to external rollups for a settlement layer, the protocol keeps throughput and security on layer 1 with parallel execution, transaction sharing and built-in rollup support, preserving decentralization without adding an extra trust layer.
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-4-title: Why is there no 'official' Quantaureum networks?
page-layer-2-faq-ExpandableCard-4-descri: Quantaureum is permissionless. Built-in rollup support is part of the base protocol, but the network itself remains a single layer-1 chain; there is no separate 'official' layer 2 and no external settlement layer.
